text_block_list.text:
Though missing out on winning the Grow Up 
Race, <chrname>'s potential received high praise 
from the Three Goddesses.

Meanwhile, the two Umamusume under Trainer 
Kashimoto's charge also showed the fruits 
of their past efforts in the Grow Up Race.

Although Happy Meek, trained by Trainer 
Kiryuin, couldn't make her debut, they 
spent their Junior year at their own pace.

It was a first year where each and every 
Trainer could truly feel the blessings of 
the Three Goddesses' support.
